description.en: The name of the pipeline job.

description.zh:
排序的顺序，取值如下，与SortBy一起使用。
- ASC：升序。
- DESC（默认值）：降序。
description.en:
The sorting order. You must specify this parameter together with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

*   ASC: ascending order.
*   DESC: descending order. This is the default value.

description.zh: 工作流任务列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的工作流任务数量，默认为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 工作流的ID集合，多个工作流ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。如何获取工作流ID，请参见[ListPipelines](~~438051~~)。
description.en: The IDs of the pipelines. Multiple pipeline IDs are separated by commas (,). You can call [ListPipelines](~~438051~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline.

description.zh: 工作流任务ID，如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见[ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~)。
description.en: The pipeline job ID. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline job.

description.zh:
用于排序的字段。目前有如下字段支持用于排序：

- PipelineId
- UserId
- ParentUserId
- StartedAt
- FinishedAt
- WorkflowServiceId
- Duration
- GmtCreateTime
- GmtModifiedTime
description.en:
The field for sorting. Valid values:

*   PipelineId
*   UserId
*   ParentUserId
*   StartedAt
*   FinishedAt
*   WorkflowServiceId
*   Duration
*   GmtCreateTime
*   GmtModifiedTime

description.zh: 工作流任务来源ID。请在工作流详情页面查看工作流任务来源ID，详情请参见[管理工作流](~~480625~~)。
description.en: The ID of the pipeline job source. You can view the ID of the pipeline job source on the pipeline details page. For more information, see [Manage pipelines](~~480625~~).

description.zh:
工作流任务来源类型，支持如下值：
- UNKNOWN（默认）：未指定来源类型时的默认值。
- SDK：通过SDK创建的工作流任务。
- DESIGNER：通过Designer创建的工作流任务。
- M6：通过其他网站创建的工作流任务。
description.en:
The type of the pipeline job source. Valid values:

*   UNKNOWN: If you do not specify this parameter, UNKNOWN is used as the default value.
*   SDK: The pipeline job is created by using an SDK.
*   DESIGNER: The pipeline job is created by using Machine Learning Designer.
*   M6: The pipeline job is created on other websites.

description.zh:
需要过滤的工作流任务的状态，目前有如下几种状态：

- Initialized
- Running
- Succeeded
- Failed
- Terminated
- Unknown
- Skipped
- Terminating
description.en:
The status of the pipeline jobs to be filtered. Valid values:

*   Initialized
*   Running
*   Succeeded
*   Failed
*   Terminated
*   Unknown
*   Skipped
*   Terminating

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.
